Beautiful setting, mediocre food
Apr 2026 • Friends
My wife and I visited Chookies because she had heard via social media that it was worth checking out. Vibes were immaculate at first and the setting of Chookie’s Beer Garden is simply gorgeous, however service was only so-so and the quality of the food and drinks left quite a bit to be desired. Seems like the kind of place that has gotten popular recently due to the trend of instagram and TikTok heavily influencing travelers as it is absolutely in a beautiful setting. We enjoyed soaking the garden in, until a group of approximately 25 Dutch youths was permitted to rudely take over the entire outdoor space, to the dismay of every single other patron in the garden. The staff allowed them to hijack the music with some weird accordion music that completely ruined the vibe. The group was extremely loud and generally disrespectful. Unfortunately the staff didn’t seem to care and allowed them to rudely dominate the space. If you base your restaurant selections on image and “instagram-ability”, then this will probably check some boxes for you. But as there are so many quality food options in the immediate vicinity of Tam Coc - both Vietnamese and Western - save yourself the trouble and try another local family spot.
